referenceFunction.generalComment: Covers high quality wood wool without shives. The multi-output process "wood wool production, u=20%" delivers the two coproducts "wood wool, u=20%, at plant" and "industrial residue wood, wood wool production, softwood, u=20%, at plant". Allocation is based on the over-all proceeds of the process.; UUID: 8e0efb3a-fa1b-3f9a-bfc2-5a3a224a672b
